dep.errSave: Could not update the automatic deposit
dep.intro: For requests from the /prenota form the system generates a {{provider}} payment link automatically and texts it to the customer. The amount and threshold below also apply to phone bookings and to the terms published on /prenota.
dep.perPersonHint: Multiplied by the number of covers. It appears in the messages to the customer and in the "Deposit and cancellations" section of the booking page.
dep.threshold: Ask for a deposit from (number of covers)
dep.thresholdHint: Bookings with at least this many people get the payment link. Below the threshold nothing changes.

exp.errSave: Could not update the link expiry
exp.title: Automatic link expiry
exp.intro: After the threshold the link can no longer be paid and a booking waiting on a deposit is declined. It applies to links from the last 7 days; table bill shares are excluded.
exp.msgDeclined: Booking not confirmed (the same wording as a manual decline)
exp.msgHint: It goes out on the channel set in the source's Reply channels (WhatsApp falling back to SMS, email).

source.MANUALHint: With blocking on, saving is refused to the staff too.

source.VOICEHint: With blocking on, Sofia declines with a polite sentence.

bl.intro: What happens when a booking comes from a number on the blacklist. The signs in the dining room (banner, badge, address book) stay visible whatever you choose.

chg.intro: They appear as bill lines and get discounted like the others. At zero they do not appear. Open orders adjust at the next entry.
chg.vatHint: The VAT rates for cover and service are set in the VAT mapping, under Tax.

pp.title: Bookings on the till
pp.subtitle: Passepartout: planner and arrivals
pp.sendHint: Bookings with a table show up in the planner. When the till opens the table, they become «Arrived» here.
pp.noPlant: Read the tables from the till to match them.
pp.syncAgent: The floor PC agent isn't ready
pp.connSubtitle: Floor PC and how the till closes CRM bills
pp.payTypeHint: A dedicated type, for example ESTERNO, so the till doesn't count the takings twice. None = tables are closed on the till by hand.
pp.payTypeFromServer: Using {{tipo}}, set on the server. Pick it here to manage it from this section.
pp.payTypeNeedsAgent: With the floor PC connected, the list shows the till's types.
pp.docTypeHint: The document the till issues when the bill is closed from the CRM.
pp.contiSubtitle: Tables closed on the till: reports, guests and reconciliation
pp.contiHint: Every 10 minutes the CRM reads the bills closed on the till: they feed the revenue report, guest spending, booking details and the cash-up reconciliation. When first switched on it fetches the last 30 days.
pp.contiToday_one: Today: {{count}} bill closed on the till · {{totale}}
pp.contiToday_other: Today: {{count}} bills closed on the till · {{totale}}
pp.contiStoricoInArrivo: Last 30 days of history on the way
pp.apertiSubtitle: Walk-ins and open tables: busy in the CRM too
pp.apertiSend: Show tables open on the till
pp.apertiHint: Every minute the CRM reads the till's open orders: those tables show as busy on the floor plan, at reception and on the bookings map, even without a booking.
pp.apertiDispHint: Sofia and online booking don't offer a table open on the till until it frees up (estimate: opening plus the shift length). Staff assigning by hand see the table busy and decide.
pp.qrSubtitle: Tables open on the till can pay from their phone
pp.qrSend: Let tables open on the till pay from the QR
pp.qrHint: The table QR shows «Pay the bill» even when the order exists only on the till. On tap the CRM reads the order, the guest pays (in full, split evenly or by dish, deposit already deducted) and once settled the till closes the table with {{tipo}}. If something is added on the till after payment, the table is not closed automatically and the till gets an alert with the difference.
pp.qrHintNoType: The table QR shows «Pay the bill» even when the order exists only on the till, and once settled the till closes the table by itself.
pp.qrNeedPay: Pay at table must be on: Settings → Pay at table.
pp.qrNeedType: Choose the till payment type above, in «Connection and till closing»: the till closes tables paid from the QR with it.
pp.qrNodo: With full service on the dining-room node, bills are opened by the node: paying till orders from the QR stays off.
pp.qrNow_one: {{count}} table open on the till right now
pp.qrNow_other: {{count}} tables open on the till right now
pp.specchioSubtitle: Till statistics and stock for bills closed in the CRM too
pp.specchioTableHint: The table where the till receives CRM bills: best one not used on the floor. If a table is open there, the copy waits until it is free.
pp.specchioNoPlant: Read the tables from the till in «Bookings on the till» to choose it.
pp.specchioGenericHint: Dishes created in the CRM, which the till doesn't have, go to the till with this item, with their own name and price. The service charge goes through it too.
pp.specchioSend: Copy CRM bills to the till
pp.specchioHint: Every bill closed in the CRM becomes an order on the chosen till table, with no kitchen tickets, closed as a pro forma paid with {{tipo}}: no receipt from the till and takings are not counted twice. The till prints the pro forma slip.
pp.specchioHintNoType: Every bill closed in the CRM becomes an order on the chosen till table, closed as a pro forma: the till payment type is required.
pp.specchioToday_one: {{count}} bill copied to the till today
pp.specchioToday_other: {{count}} bills copied to the till today
pp.specchioFailed_one: {{count}} bill not copied to the till
pp.specchioFailed_other: {{count}} bills not copied to the till
